profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
• Veteran Front-End Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience, delivering cutting-edge mobile applications and scalable web platforms within fast-paced environments.
• Extensive technical skill set with proficiency in Java, Kotlin, Dart, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Objective-C. Specializing in Android, Flutter, and web development, with additional iOS expertise, delivering aesthetically pleasing and intuitive user experiences.
• Impactful contributions during each phase of the Software Development Life Cycle, from requirements analysis and architecture design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
• Prolific developer, with a track record of successful applications including Sleep Timer with over 5 million downloads, contributions to Google Play Books with 1 billion downloads, and Google Search enhancements affecting 50% of global daily users and 1% of queries, in addition to the authoring of popular open-source libraries with 2,300 stars and 600 stars on GitHub.
• Successful entrepreneur, Founder of several technology startups, leveraging leadership experience, business acumen and technical abilities to grow successful ventures.
• Engaged collaborator with strong interpersonal skills, able to influence and align cross-functional teams with conflicting priorities to drive progress under aggressive time constraints.
• Respected leader with hands-on people management experience, and who greatly cares about recruiting & nurturing talent, while developing a culture of excellence.

positions.title: GM & Software Engineer, Sleep Timer
positions.description:
Sleep Timer is an application that helps users turn off their music or video while they are sleeping. This app is a complete re-design and rebuild of the original Music Off app, created from scratch, based on user data and feedback from the previous version.

 • Leveraged years of skills and knowledge to launch a luxurious app in terms of UI and engineering
 • As the PM, developed everything from the product roadmap to the detailed aspects of the product
 • As the lead engineer, re-designed and re-implemented the entire application from scratch
 • Led and managed a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and translators
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Java · Kotlin · Flutter · Dart · iOS · Leadership · Entrepreneurship · Start-ups · Product Management · User Experience

positions.title: Co-founder & GM, Start-up at Area 120
positions.description:
Founded and built an AI-powered comics start-up at Google’s in-house incubator, Area 120. The platform allows comics creators to freely share their work and monetize it, similar to YouTube. One of the key goals was to innovate the comics creation process by leveraging Google’s AI technology, making it easier for creators and resulting in more engaging content.

[Investment]
Conducted 6 fundraising and interim report pitches, securing approval to continue the project, which resulted in three rounds of funding—each supporting 6 months of operations—that covered 5-8 headcounts and provided $XXXk for additional expenses.

[Management]
Built and managed a high-performing cross-functional team of 5 direct reports and 10 extended contributors, including engineers, designers, partnership managers, and UX researchers.

[Product]
Developed the product roadmap based on user research, identifying and prioritizing user needs to create actionable 6-month plans. The first phase involved launching the product to 50-100 in-house comics creators and readers, followed by a second phase that introduced the Android and iOS apps to 500 trusted users.

[Engineering]
Compared and analyzed key frameworks and libraries to select the best options for development. Reviewed documentation and communicated daily with backend and frontend developers to anticipate and resolve potential issues. Collaborated with designers to finalize product designs in advance, ensuring a smooth engineering process without bottlenecks. Stepped in as an individual contributor to address critical engineering needs when resources were limited.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Google Play Books
positions.description:
[Server Driven UI]
Server Driven UI was a new architectural pattern applied by our team, involving close collaboration between the backend and frontend teams. In this approach, the server determines the content to be displayed on each page, and the frontend renders the UI based on the data provided by the server.
 • Designed and implemented modules on the detail and home pages to support Server Driven UI

[Google Play Dialog]
Google Play Dialog is a unified dialog library designed for the Google Play family apps. This library supports various views that can be stacked vertically to accommodate different dialog formats and purposes. On mobile devices, dialogs appear as bottomsheets, while on tablets, they are displayed as traditional dialogs.
 • Worked closely with a cross-functional team to design the new dialog library to meet the requirements
 • Implemented Google Play Dialog for the Play family teams and provided consultation for their integration
 • Integrated the new library to update over 40 different types of dialogs in the Play Books app

[Google Play Design Revamp]
The goal of this project was to update the Google Play family apps—Play Store, Play Games, Play Books, and Play Movies—to follow the Material Design 2 Guidelines and ensure a consistent look and feel them. For this effort, Google Play family teams collaborated to create unified design revamp libraries and modules.
 • Designed and implemented various libraries: dialog, bottomsheet, appbar, bottom nav, and themes
 • Integrated design revamp libraries into the Play Books Android app by updating all pages and views
 • Worked closely with colleagues across the Google Play family teams

[Chromecast Integration]
This project aimed to integrate Google Chromecast and Google Assistant into Google Play Books apps
 • Designed and implemented Chromecast V3 integration, the first case of integration within Google
 • Collaborated closely with various teams including the Chromecast team and Google Assistant team

positions.title: Software Engineer, Google Search
positions.description:
Participated in the Search Result Page revamp project, which aimed to create a more organized version of the Google search result page. This revamp allows users to view related content in a tab format on mobile when searching for topics such as movies, TV series, finance, people, books, and weather.

 • Designed and implemented modules from data pipelining to frontend UI
 • Implemented the Top Results module, impacting about XX% of worldwide search DAU
 • Implemented the Disambiguation module, affecting more than X% of all search queries

positions.title: GM & Software Engineer, Music Off version 2
positions.description:
Music Off is a sleep timer application that helps users turn off their music or video while they are sleeping. Min and I undertook a complete re-design and re-implementation of the app from scratch, six years after the release of the first version. This effort was aimed at aligning the app with the latest Google Material Design guidelines and Android development technologies.

 • Re-designed and re-implemented the entire Android application from scratch
 • Integrated newest Android technologies such as Kotlin, Dagger, and PreferenceFragment

positions.title: GM & Software Engineer, Bubblics
positions.description:
Bubblics is a photo sticker application that allows you to enhance your photos with unique emojis and customizable stickers.

 • Designed and implemented the entire Android application and website
 • Designed the user experience and developed the product roadmap
 • Implemented key features such as pinching, rotating, editing stickers, and image processing

positions.title: GM, The Finest Artist, Branding
positions.description: Branding effort for The Finest Artist company, including CI design, logo creation, and selection of brand colors and fonts. Collaborated with designer Min Kim by providing ideas and conceptual direction.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Place is a social network service that allows people to discover, join, and express themselves in groups of like-minded people.

 • Re-designed and refactored the analytics and push notification system of Android application
 • Designed the UX and implemented the community creation process within the Android application
 • Worked closely with Mike, the iOS developer, and reviewed his iOS code

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Globee is a native tutor matching service for learning foreign languages, featuring a user interface similar to Tinder's swipe UX.

 • Designed and implemented the entire Android application
 • Developed key features such as swiping UX, in-app messenger, notifications, and meeting scheduler
 • Designed and implemented the entire backend service using Meta's Parse with custom APIs
 • Led and managed iOS engineers, a designer, and a product manager

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Realm is an open-source mobile database that can replace iOS Core Data and Android SQLite. Conducted presentations at GDG I/O Extended, GDG monthly meet-ups, and Realm developer meet-ups to advocate for Realm.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Moving Key is a keyboard application that provides extra keys by moving them up, down, left, or right. Developed the Android application and re-designed the UI and UX for Moving Key.

Tilt Code is a mobile application with a sophisticated algorithm for finding someone or something nearby, supporting a messaging system using smartphone sensors such as the gyroscope, orientation sensor, and GPS. Developed the back-end server and Android application for the MVP version of Tilt Code.

positions.title: Co-founder & CEO
positions.description:
Bttendance is a mobile-based teaching assistant service. It features an automatic attendance check system using Bluetooth, a clicker to increase student participation, a notification system to inform students of important information, and a Q&A forum.

Highlights:
 • Implemented in over 200 classes with more than 5,000 students signed up
 • Filed a patent to protect the automatic attendance checking system

Key Contributions:
 • Led, managed, and recruited engineers, designers, and the business team
 • Designed the user experience for both Android and iOS applications and developed the product roadmap
 • Designed and implemented the entire Android, iOS, and web applications
 • Designed and implemented the entire API and backend server to handle high concurrent API calls
 • Developed an automatic attendance check system using smartphone Bluetooth and socket.io
 • Conducted investment rounds to secure funding, including government funding
positions.insights: Skills: Android · Java · iOS · Leadership · Entrepreneurship · Start-ups · Product Management · User Experience · JavaScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Vingle is an interest-based community with features similar to Facebook and Pinterest, including liking, commenting, and pinning content. It achieved No.1 in the News & Magazine category in South Korea and was featured as a staff pick on the Google Play Store.

 • Co-developed the Android application from scratch to 4 months after the official launch with Chansuk
 • Developed key features including signup, login, post, like, comment, pin, search, and notifications
 • Refactored the entire Android application structure to follow Google's Material Design guidelines

positions.title: GM & Software Engineer, Music Off
positions.description:
Music Off is a sleep timer application that helps users turn off their music or video while they are sleeping.

Highlights:
 • The Android application has reached over 5 million downloads
 • Supported both Android (released 2011) and iOS applications (released 2012)
 • Featured as a top trending application and top music app on the Google Play Store
 • Featured on Naver and Nate, two of the biggest portal services in South Korea
 • Introduced on Arirang TV, the international broadcast of South Korea

Key Contributions:
 • Designed the user experience for both Android and iOS applications and developed the product roadmap
 • Led and managed a team of iOS engineers, designers, marketers, and translators
 • Designed and implemented the entire Android application and 90% of the iOS application
 • Developed key features such as background service, app widgets, and media controls
 • Developed an auto sleep detection algorithm that tracks whether the user is asleep
 • Integrated in-app purchase and AdMob for monetization and Google Analytics to analyze user data
 • Requested app introduction to influential bloggers in Korea, Japan, and the US
 • Conducted Facebook marketing, reaching 10,000 likes on the page

positions.title: Team Lead & Product Manager, MusiCon
positions.description:
MusiCon is a music player with an LP disc-inspired user interface, featuring a timer, alarm, timeline, and social features.

 • Led the team and managed the project as team lead and PM
 • Designed the user experience and developed the product roadmap
 • Oversaw the development of features like timer, alarm, timeline, and social integration

honors.title: Github Trending Developer in Java - Top 5 as Individual
honors.description: Recognized as a top 5 individual Github Trending Developer in Java from December 2015 to March 2016, based on my open-source projects "FinestWebView" (over 2,000 stars) and "AndroidBaseUtils" (over 600 stars). These projects gained significant popularity and were trending during this period, showcasing the impact and utility of my contributions to the open-source community.

honors.title: Google Developer Group Hackathon - 2nd Prize
honors.description: Awarded 2nd prize for developing "Handbell Choir Hero" Android and Web application using Firebase. The hackathon involved over 50 participants working in teams over three days. My teammate Gabriel and I developed a fun app that allows multiple users to play handbells in harmony using their phones or computers.
honors.issuer: Issued by NYC Google Developer Group · Nov 2015

projects.title: FinestWebView
projects.description:
FinestWebView is an Android library that allows developers to create a seamless and visually appealing web viewing experience within their Android applications. It supports Material Design, custom themes, transition animations, modern UI elements, and more.

 • 𝗥𝗘𝗖𝗜𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗗 𝗢𝗩𝗘𝗥 𝟮,𝟬𝟬𝟬 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗥𝗦 and featured as a 𝗧𝗥𝗘𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗝𝗔𝗩𝗔 𝗟𝗜𝗕𝗥𝗔𝗥𝗬 on Github
 • Collaborated with a designer to ensure seamless integration with each app's theme
 • Designed a developer-friendly API for easy integration
 • Completed migration of all code from 𝗝𝗔𝗩𝗔 𝗧𝗢 𝗞𝗢𝗧𝗟𝗜𝗡

projects.title: AndroidBaseUtils
projects.description:
AndroidBaseUtils is a comprehensive Android utility library that simplifies common tasks and enhances productivity. Key features include context management, logging, resource handling, preference management, and various utility classes to streamline Android development.

 • 𝗥𝗘𝗖𝗜𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗗 𝗢𝗩𝗘𝗥 𝟲𝟬𝟬 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗥𝗦 on Github
 • Implemented over 20-30 utility classes heavily used in Android development
